domain: RNA metabolic labeling, thiol chemistry, enrichment and sequencing recoding
relationship_to_existing_design: Domain-specific scientific checks for assertions in docs/COMPARISON_PROFILES.md. This is not a new graph schema, universal stage grammar, universal set of assay requirements, or an admission certificate.
scope_and_limits: Actual accessible Methods and primary experimental results were read; named methods were not assessed from abstracts alone.

The original 2017 TUC-seq publisher page supplied only its abstract and supplement listing. Its supplement and full-text links failed. Detailed TUC chemistry below relies on an explicitly identified independent primary replication, not claimed access to the original supplement.
No extraction runs, SSH sessions, code changes, frozen-runtime changes, or wet-lab validation were performed.
No source text is quoted verbatim. Rules are locally proposed scientific judgments; source reports and local inferences are distinguished.

sources.title: Herzog et al. 2017, Thiol-linked alkylation of RNA to assess expression dynamics
actually_accessed_sections: Results: Detection of 4-thiouridine by sequencing; Figure 1
Online Methods: Carboxyamidomethylation of s4U; Mass Spectrometry; Primer extension assays
Online Methods: SLAM-seq in mESCs; RNA library preparation
Discussion: short-pulse sensitivity and library scope
sources.access: Full author manuscript HTML, including Online Methods. Supplement listing accessed; supplement contents not relied upon.

facts.text: SLAM-seq treats extracted RNA with iodoacetamide, attaching a carboxyamidomethyl group to 4sU sulfur by substitution. The RNA product remains a modified thiouridine; the apparent T>C readout is RT dependent.

The study separately measured chemical alkylation, RT drop-off and sequencing changes using defined RNA and negative controls. High efficiency and negligible additional RT drop-off were established in the tested conditions, not all substrates.

Cellular labeling preceded RNA isolation, alkylation and library construction. The discussion identifies uptake kinetics, transcriptional activity and sequencing depth as short-pulse detection limits. QuantSeq restricted the demonstrated library to polyadenylated RNA ends.

sources.title: Schofield et al. 2018, TimeLapse-seq: Adding a temporal dimension to RNA sequencing through nucleoside recoding
actually_accessed_sections: Main text and Figure 1: oxidation and aminolysis; product identification
Online Methods: LC-MS analysis of nucleosides; NMR analysis of nucleobase chemistry
Online Methods: NotI restriction endonuclease assay; Primer extension assay; Targeted TimeLapse sequencing
Online Methods: Transcriptome-wide TimeLapse-seq; TT-TimeLapse-seq
Online Methods: data fitting and correction for labeled-RNA loss
sources.access: Full author manuscript HTML including Online Methods. Supplement listings accessed; supplement documents not opened successfully.

facts.text: Optimized TimeLapse chemistry uses sodium periodate and 2,2,2-trifluoroethylamine on isolated RNA. Oxidative substitution/aminolysis produces an N4-trifluoroethyl cytidine analogue. Earlier mCPBA nucleoside assays are distinct experimental conditions.

Chemistry was examined by LC-MS/NMR and through RT-dependent assays. Measured cDNA T>C conversion is distinct from chemical product yield. Modeling accounts for uridines per read and background; the authors corrected modest labeled-RNA loss for half-life estimation.

TT-TimeLapse-seq first enriches thiolated RNA through MTS-biotin/streptavidin chemistry, then applies TimeLapse chemistry to eluate and input. Affinity enrichment and recoding can therefore coexist in one method.

facts.text: The protocol separates cellular exposure, RNA isolation and chemical treatment. Label dose and duration depend on cell type and question. Dark/reducing handling protects thiolated RNA; RNA integrity and label-plus-chemistry-dependent mutation increases are expected controls.

sources.access: Full publisher HTML Methods; PMC URL initially returned a browser challenge.

facts.text: After cellular 4sU pulses around DRB removal, extracted RNA is reacted with Biotin-HPDP, captured on streptavidin beads and released using DTT. Libraries omit poly(A) isolation and use random-primed RT. This is affinity selection, not a designed T>C recoding operation.

Both 4- and 8-minute post-release samples receive the final 8-minute label pulse. Elongation inference uses recovery fronts and intronic coverage with gene/replicate filters; mature-RNA contamination motivates intron analysis.

sources.access: Actual eighteen-page primary author manuscript PDF through CDC; PMC direct page challenged.

facts.text: HPDP-biotin and MTS-biotin form reversible RNA-linked disulfides, with streptavidin capture and reductive release. Their reaction efficiencies differ. Limited incorporation favors recovery of longer, U-rich RNA. Defined thiolated/nonthiolated RNAs and external standards test specificity and recovery.

sources.title: Ohashi et al. 2024, Development and Comparison of 4-Thiouridine to Cytidine Base Conversion Reaction
actually_accessed_sections: PDF pages 2-4: Materials and Methods 2.1-2.5: substrates, transcription, OsO4/NH4Cl, IAA, NaIO4/TFEA
PDF page 5: Results 3.1.1-3.1.3: HPLC/mass characterization
PDF pages 6-7: Results 3.2.1-3.2.3: labeled RNA transcript and RT/PCR outcomes
sources.access: Actual nine-page primary experimental comparison PDF. This is an independent replication, not the original TUC-seq Methods.

facts.text: The OsO4/NH4Cl route produces native cytidine, unlike the alkylated or N4-substituted products. Methods explicitly treat RNA before RT. Small-substrate tests use 4-thiodeoxyuridine-containing trimers; transcript tests use a 751-nt RNA with all 147 U positions replaced by 4sU.

Results vary between short substrates and densely labeled RNA; IAA impaired long-amplicon recovery in that context. This does not universally refute the original single-site RT result. Conversion, integrity and amplification outcomes need their tested substrate and conditions.
The paper notes periodate oxidation of the RNA terminal vicinal diol.
facts.evidence_scope: Chemical limitation described in the paper with reference to earlier work; not a new terminal-ligation compatibility measurement in this study.

sources.title: Matsushima et al. 2019, Sequencing cell type-specific transcriptomes with SLAM-ITseq
actually_accessed_sections: Development of the protocol; Applications; Limitations
Experimental design: Mouse breeding, 4-thiouracil administration, RNA extraction, IAA treatment
Procedure: IAA treatment steps 26-35; RNA-seq library preparation
sources.access: Actual full primary protocol HTML including procedure and control design.

facts.text: Cell-specific 4-thiouracil labeling uses Cre-dependent UPRT expression. Cre-negative animals receive matched precursor exposure to estimate UPRT-independent background. Promoter leakage, transgene specificity and label accessibility limit attribution. IAA chemistry then reads thiolated RNA from whole-tissue extracts.

The protocol recommends RNA quality checks, fresh IAA and an alkylation-positive control. It demonstrates different RT-containing library formats; a shared chemical readout does not identify the cell origin without the biological labeling design.

unaccessed_priority_source.title: Riml et al. 2017, Osmium-Mediated Transformation of 4-Thiouridine to Cytidine as Key To Study RNA Dynamics by Sequencing
actually_accessed_sections: Abstract and supporting-information listing only
unaccessed_priority_source.effect: Do not cite this audit as a reading of original TUC experimental details. S6 supplies the inspected primary experimental basis for bounded chemistry claims.

proposed_rules.check: Identify the material acted on and where the action occurs: cellular nucleotide incorporation, chemical modification of isolated RNA, copying into cDNA, or selection of an RNA population. Compare the selected transformation scope, not method-name similarity.
proposed_rules.outcome_logic: A known stage/material difference is supported_difference at that resolution. Unknown material or reaction location is unresolved when essential to the proposed shared mechanism.

proposed_rules.check: Keep administered precursor, incorporated RNA residue and post-treatment product distinct. A different cellular precursor/salvage path can converge on the same downstream RNA substrate; it need not exclude a shared downstream transformation.
proposed_rules.outcome_logic: Assess biological incorporation separately from downstream chemistry; do not invent a common incorporation route.

proposed_rules.check: Declare the mechanistic resolution before judgment. Same T>C readout supports a common information effect; exact reaction matching needs source-supported reacting group, reaction class and consequential product identity. Compare known intermediates only when they matter at that resolution.
proposed_rules.outcome_logic: Missing essential chemistry blocks an exact mechanism claim. Missing a transient intermediate does not block a supported broader chemical family. A reagent word alone cannot fill missing chemistry.

proposed_rules.check: Record the chemical output where established: sulfur-bound alkyl adduct, substituted cytidine, native cytidine, or reversible affinity conjugate. Do not turn every apparent conversion into native-base replacement.
proposed_rules.outcome_logic: Different products exclude exact product equivalence while potentially preserving broader mechanism-family agreement. Unknown product identity remains unresolved at the exact-product level.

proposed_rules.check: Distinguish physical enrichment from molecular sequence recoding. Ask whether the information is a selected fraction, a per-site signature, or both. Capture alone identifies a retained molecule/fragment, not the exact incorporated nucleotide position.
proposed_rules.outcome_logic: Do not impose mutually exclusive method classes; evaluate actual operations and retained branches.

proposed_rules.check: Specify which molecule carries the physical change and which carries the reported sequence. Normalize transcript/read strand conventions before comparing mutation symbols. In an RT workflow, a changed RNA template and a stable cDNA mutation are different events.
proposed_rules.outcome_logic: RNA versus cDNA is consequential; a complementary-strand symbol difference alone is not evidence of different chemistry.

proposed_rules.check: Separate chemical yield, label incorporation, polymerase read-through, misincorporation probability, per-U mutation frequency, and fraction of molecules classified as new. Require the denominator and tested substrate for quantitative equality claims.
proposed_rules.outcome_logic: Same family does not confer identical efficiency, sensitivity or preservation. No particular mass spectrometer, RT brand or sequencing instrument is universally required.

proposed_rules.check: For a demonstrated label-specific recoding property, seek matched label/chemistry negatives, known labeled and unlabeled substrate controls, background mutation handling, and RNA/RT recovery checks appropriate to the claim. Distinguish a described mechanism from performance demonstrated in the submitted context.
proposed_rules.outcome_logic: A missing contextual control limits the demonstrated property, not automatically a well-supported mechanism-family membership. Do not demand every control from every unrelated operation.

proposed_rules.check: Temporal interpretation needs pulse/chase schedule, exposure and uptake, survival until harvest, labeling/detection sensitivity and relevant kinetic assumptions. A label marks synthesis during availability; it does not identify an exact transcription-initiation instant.
proposed_rules.inference_label: The statement about exact initiation time is a local consequence of nucleotide incorporation into elongating RNA, not a quoted source conclusion.
proposed_rules.outcome_logic: A zero-signature read is not automatically old RNA. Different pulse contexts can share chemistry while supporting different temporal conclusions.

proposed_rules.check: For enrichment properties, examine incorporation and coupling efficiency, U content/length, wash stringency, nonspecific carryover, recovery and normalization controls. Keep label-dependent capture probability separate from abundance and synthesis rate.
proposed_rules.outcome_logic: Shared capture family does not establish equal bias or recovery. Missing recovery data leaves contextual quantitative equivalence unresolved.

proposed_rules.check: Cell-of-origin attribution requires evidence for restricted label activation/delivery or another origin-preserving design, including appropriate background and specificity controls. A metabolic mark alone supplies neither a unique cell barcode nor a heritable clone identity.
proposed_rules.inference_label: The exclusion of unique clone identity is a local identifiability conclusion.
proposed_rules.outcome_logic: Shared downstream chemistry can coexist with different or absent origin information. Unknown origin is unresolved, not evidence of absent incorporation.

proposed_rules.check: Bound preservation, RT fidelity and amplification claims to the actual substrate, label density, enzyme, conditions and assay. Small-substrate chemistry or a single-site RT test cannot establish transcript-wide contextual behavior.
proposed_rules.outcome_logic: Retain mechanism-family agreement when context changes; treat newly asserted performance as unresolved until supported. Do not universalize a bounded failure either.

proposed_rules.check: Future interface compatibility needs actual chemical end state, residual reagents, cleanup, RNA integrity and the proposed downstream substrate requirements. Chemical recoding can precede different readers; reader performance still needs evidence.
proposed_rules.outcome_logic: Do not infer incompatibility from untested transfer, or validated direct-RNA recognition from an RT-based demonstration. A direct-RNA workflow must not acquire a fictional RT step.

proposed_rules.check: Treat DRB synchronization, release fronts, intronic quantification and filtering as part of the declared elongation-inference scope. Shared thiol incorporation or capture cannot establish the same transcriptional estimand.
proposed_rules.outcome_logic: A capture operation may match while the larger temporal-measurement scope differs.

proposed_rules.check: Allow connected operation groups with source-supported interfaces. Retain every consequential chemical, selection and information step in the selected scope; do not invent intermediates to force a one-to-one alignment.
proposed_rules.outcome_logic: Changing graph granularity alone must not change chemical judgment. A broad purpose match must not be promoted to a whole-scope mechanism match.

proposed_rules.check: Read the actual published protocol version and material path. Neither a kit's current instructions nor an enzyme name establishes which nucleic acid was acted on or read in an older experiment. Missing RT/PCR detail must remain unknown unless the source supports presence, absence or non-applicability.
proposed_rules.outcome_logic: Do not infer a DNA substrate from a reagent's name or require cDNA/PCR for an RNA workflow. Compare source-reported chemistry before reader architecture.

not_identifiable_from_shared_mechanism_a: Historical ancestry, reuse or independent invention.
Experimental interchangeability or preservation in an untested cellular, RNA, support or reader context.
The exact age or initiation time of an individual transcript.
Old versus newly synthesized identity of every zero-signature read.
Absolute synthesis and decay rates without time design, normalization and kinetic assumptions.
Unique cell identity, clonal lineage, or cell-type restriction without a separate origin-preserving design.
Unbiased recovery, universal transcript coverage, equal chemical yield or equal RT fidelity.
Exact chemical product or reaction path from a T>C signal alone.
minimal_implementation_guidance: Use these checks as mechanism-specific reviewer requirements attached to the existing purpose/mechanism/context assertions; do not add a new universal operation grammar.

Record declared resolution, required property, applicability reason, observed evidence and outcome. Only supported_agreement on every essential applicable property can justify that scoped mechanism claim.
Keep unresolved interface/property evidence from becoming either agreement or incompatibility. A contextual unknown need not block a narrower supported family claim.
Bind each reported source fact to the actual selected operation/state and reopened passage. This audit is a candidate scientific rule set, not inherited evidence for future extractions.
